translations.idiomatic: Dalai Sun led more than a hundred thousand horsemen into Guangning; Yin Shangzhi died in battle.

sentences.zh: 忬停俸三月。

translations.literal: Yu's salary was suspended three months.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's salary was suspended three months.

sentences.zh: 未幾，打來孫復以十萬騎屯青城，分遣精騎犯一片石、三道關。

translations.literal: Before long Dalai Sun again encamped at Qingcheng with a hundred thousand horsemen, sending elite cavalry to violate Yipianshi and Sandao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Dalai Sun again encamped at Qingcheng with a hundred thousand horsemen, sending elite cavalry against Yipianshi and Sandao Pass.

sentences.zh: 總兵官歐陽安拒卻之。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ouyang An repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ouyang An repelled them.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When reported, silver and silks were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Silver and silks were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 把都兒等犯遷安，副總兵蔣承勛戰死。

translations.literal: Badu'er and others violated Qian'an; Vice Commander Jiang Chengxun died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Badu'er violated Qian'an; Vice Commander Jiang Chengxun died in battle.

sentences.zh: 降忬兵部侍郎，留任。

translations.literal: Yu was demoted to Vice Minister of War but retained his post.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was demoted to Vice Minister of War but retained his post.

sentences.zh: 初，帝器忬才，甚眷之。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor valued Yu's talent and favored him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor valued Yu's talent and favored him greatly.

sentences.zh: 及所部屢失事，則以為不足辦寇，諭嚴嵩與兵部計防守之宜。

translations.literal: When his jurisdiction repeatedly suffered failures, he was deemed insufficient to handle bandits; Yan Song was instructed with the Ministry of War on defense.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated failures he was deemed insufficient; Yan Song and the Ministry of War were instructed on defense.

sentences.zh: 嵩奏流河口邊墻有缺，故寇乘之入，宜大修邊墻。

translations.literal: Song memorialized that the frontier wall at Liukou had gaps through which bandits entered and the wall should be greatly repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Song said the wall at Liukou had gaps and should be greatly repaired.

sentences.zh: 且令忬選補額兵，操練戰守，不得專恃他鎮援兵。

translations.literal: Yu was to select and fill allotted troops, drill them for battle and defense, and not rely solely on relief from other garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was to fill allotted troops and drill them, not rely solely on relief troops.

sentences.zh: 部條六事，如嵩指。

translations.literal: The ministry submitted six items as Song directed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry submitted six items as Song directed.

sentences.zh: 帝乃下詔責忬，赦其罪，實主兵，減客兵，如議。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict blaming Yu, pardoned his guilt, made allotted troops primary and guest troops secondary as discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Yu, pardoned him, made allotted troops primary and guest troops secondary.

sentences.zh: 於是練兵之議起。

translations.literal: Thereupon the discussion of drilling troops arose.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon drilling allotted troops was discussed.

sentences.zh: 時寇別部入沈陽，有鄉兵金仲良者擒其長討賴。

translations.literal: At that time a separate band entered Shenyang; militiaman Jin Zhongliang captured their leader Tolai.
translations.idiomatic: A band entered Shenyang; militiaman Jin Zhongliang captured leader Tolai.

sentences.zh: 忬賚銀幣，官仲良三級。

translations.literal: Yu was rewarded with silver and silks and Zhongliang promoted three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Yu received silver and silks; Zhongliang was promoted three grades.

sentences.zh: 防秋畢，復忬官。

translations.literal: When autumn defense ended Yu's office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When autumn defense ended Yu's office was restored.

sentences.zh: 尋復用沈陽卻寇功，蔭一子。

translations.literal: Soon hereditary privilege for one son was granted for repelling raiders at Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon hereditary privilege for one son was granted for repelling Shenyang raiders.

sentences.zh: 已而寇復入遼陽，副總兵王重祿敗績。

translations.literal: Before long raiders again entered Liaoyang and Vice Commander Wang Chonglu was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders again entered Liaoyang and Vice Commander Wang Chonglu was defeated.

sentences.zh: 御史周斯盛以聞。

translations.literal: Censor Zhou Sisheng reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhou Sisheng reported this.

sentences.zh: 帝置忬不問，治他將吏如律。

translations.literal: The emperor left Yu unpunished and punished other officers according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left Yu unpunished and punished other officers.

sentences.zh: 初，帝從楊博言，命薊鎮入衛兵聽宣大調遣。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor, following Yang Bo, ordered Ji garrison interior-defense troops to obey Xuan and Da dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor ordered Ji interior-defense troops to obey Xuan and Da dispatch.

sentences.zh: 忬言：「古北諸口無險可守，獨恃入衛卒護陵京，奈何聽調發？」

translations.literal: Yu said: "At Gubei and other passes there is no terrain to defend; we rely solely on interior-defense troops to protect the tombs and capital—how can they be dispatched?
translations.idiomatic: Yu said: "Gubei passes have no terrain to defend; we rely on interior-defense troops for tombs and capital—how can they be dispatched?

sentences.zh: 帝怒曰：「曩令薊鎮練兵，今一卒不練，遇防秋輒調他鎮兵，兵部詳議以聞。」

translations.literal: The emperor angrily said: "I ordered Ji to drill troops; now not one is drilled, and at autumn defense other garrisons are always called—let the ministry deliberate and report."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor angrily said: "I ordered Ji to drill troops; none are drilled, and other garrisons are always called—the ministry shall report."

sentences.zh: 部臣言：「薊鎮額兵多缺，宜察補」。

translations.literal: Ministry officials said: "Ji allotted troops are greatly deficient and should be inspected and filled."
translations.idiomatic: Ministry officials said Ji allotted troops were deficient and should be filled.

sentences.zh: 乃遣郎中唐順之往核。

translations.literal: Bureau Director Tang Shunzhi was sent to verify.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau Director Tang Shunzhi was sent to verify.

sentences.zh: 還奏額兵九萬有奇，今惟五萬七千，又皆羸老。

translations.literal: On return he reported allotted troops should exceed ninety thousand; now only fifty-seven thousand remained, all weak and old.
translations.idiomatic: He reported allotted troops should exceed ninety thousand; only fifty-seven thousand weak and old remained.

sentences.zh: 忬與總兵官安、巡撫馬珮及諸將袁正等，俱宜按治。

translations.literal: Yu, Regional Commander An, Grand Coordinator Ma Pei, and Generals Yuan Zheng and others should all be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Yu, An, Ma Pei, and Yuan Zheng should all be punished.

sentences.zh: 乃降忬俸二級。

translations.literal: Yu's salary was reduced two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's salary was reduced two grades.

sentences.zh: 帝因問嵩：「邊兵入衛，舊制乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor then asked Song: "Are frontier troops entering interior defense an old institution?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Song: "Is dispatching frontier troops interior an old institution?

sentences.zh: 嵩曰：「祖宗時無調邊兵入內地者。

translations.literal: Song said: "In ancestral times frontier troops were never dispatched to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Song said: "Ancestrally frontier troops were never dispatched inland.

sentences.zh: 正德中劉六猖獗，始調許泰、郤永領邊兵討賊。

translations.literal: In Zhengde when Liu Six was rampant, Xu Tai and Xi Yong were first dispatched with frontier troops to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde when Liu Six was rampant, Xu Tai and Xi Yong were first dispatched inland.

sentences.zh: 庚戌之變，仇鸞選邊兵十八支護陵京，未用以守薊鎮。

translations.literal: In the gengxu crisis Qiu Luan selected eighteen frontier detachments to protect tombs and the capital, not yet used to defend Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the gengxu crisis Qiu Luan selected eighteen detachments for tombs and capital.

sentences.zh: 至何棟始借二支防守，忬始盡調邊兵守要害，去歲又征全遼士馬入關，致寇乘虛入犯，遼左一空。

translations.literal: Only when He Dong began borrowing two detachments for defense did Yu dispatch all frontier troops to critical points; last year all Liaodong troops were summoned inside, letting bandits enter on the empty frontier.
translations.idiomatic: He Dong borrowed two detachments; Yu dispatched all frontier troops; last year all Liaodong troops were summoned inside, leaving the frontier empty.

sentences.zh: 若年復一年，調發不已，豈惟糜餉，更有他憂。」

translations.literal: If year after year dispatch continues, not only will provisions be wasted but other troubles will arise.
translations.idiomatic: If dispatch continues yearly, provisions will be wasted and other troubles arise.

sentences.zh: 帝由是惡忬甚。

translations.literal: The emperor thereby hated Yu greatly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereby hated Yu greatly.

sentences.zh: 逾月，寇犯清河，總兵官楊照禦之，斬首八百余級。

translations.literal: A month later raiders violated Qinghe; Regional Commander Yang Zhao resisted and took more than eight hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: A month later raiders violated Qinghe; Yang Zhao took more than eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 越四日，土蠻十萬騎薄界嶺口，副將馬芳拒卻之。

translations.literal: Four days later Tumen led a hundred thousand horsemen to Jieling Pass; Vice Commander Ma Fang repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Four days later Tumen led a hundred thousand horsemen to Jieling Pass; Ma Fang repelled them.

sentences.zh: 明日，敵騎二百奔還，芳及安俘斬四十級。

translations.literal: The next day two hundred enemy horsemen fled back; Fang and An captured and beheaded forty.
translations.idiomatic: The next day two hundred enemy horsemen fled; Fang and An beheaded forty.

sentences.zh: 忬猶被賚。

translations.literal: Yu still received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Yu still received rewards.

sentences.zh: 三十八年二月，把都兒、辛愛數部屯會州，挾朵顏為鄉導，將西入，聲言東。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-eighth year Badu'er, Xin'ai, and several bands encamped at Huizhou, using Tumed as guides, intending to enter west while proclaiming east.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-eighth year Badu'er and Xin'ai encamped at Huizhou, using Tumed guides, feinting east while entering west.

sentences.zh: 忬遽引兵東。

translations.literal: Yu hastily led troops east.
translations.idiomatic: Yu hastily led troops east.

sentences.zh: 寇乃以其間由潘家口入，渡灤河而西，大掠遵化、遷安、薊州、玉田，駐內地五日，京師大震。

translations.literal: The bandits in the interval entered through Panjiakou, crossed the Luan River west, plundered Zunhua, Qian'an, Jizhou, and Yutian, encamped inland five days—the capital was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders entered through Panjiakou, crossed the Luan west, plundered Zunhua, Qian'an, Jizhou, and Yutian five days—the capital shook.

sentences.zh: 御史王漸、方輅遂劾忬、安及巡撫王輪罪。

translations.literal: Censors Wang Jian and Fang Lu impeached Yu, An, and Grand Coordinator Wang Lun.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Wang Jian and Fang Lu impeached Yu, An, and Wang Lun.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，斥安，貶輪於外，切責忬，令停俸自效。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angered, dismissed An, demoted Lun outside, sharply blamed Yu, and ordered salary suspended pending merit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed An, demoted Lun, blamed Yu, and suspended his salary.

sentences.zh: 至五月，輅復劾忬失策者三，可罪者四，遂命逮忬及中軍遊擊張倫下詔獄。

translations.literal: By the fifth month Lu again impeached three failures and four offenses; Yu and Raiding Commander Zhang Lun were arrested.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month Lu impeached Yu again; Yu and Zhang Lun were arrested.

sentences.zh: 刑部論忬戍邊，帝手批曰：「諸將皆斬，主軍令者顧得附輕典耶？」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments sentenced Yu to frontier banishment; the emperor wrote by hand: "All generals are beheaded—shall the commander of military law receive a light sentence?
translations.idiomatic: The ministry sentenced banishment; the emperor wrote: "All generals are beheaded—shall the commander receive a light sentence?

sentences.zh: 改論斬。

translations.literal: The sentence was changed to execution.
translations.idiomatic: The sentence was changed to execution.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，竟死西市。

translations.literal: The next winter he was executed at the West Market.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter he was executed at the West Market.

sentences.zh: 忬才本通敏。

translations.literal: Yu's talent was originally keen and versatile.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's talent was keen and versatile.

sentences.zh: 其驟拜都御史，及屢更督撫也，皆帝特簡，所建請無不從。

translations.literal: His abrupt appointment as censor-in-chief and repeated changes as grand coordinator were all special selections by the emperor; his proposals were never refused.
translations.idiomatic: His abrupt promotions were imperial selections; his proposals were never refused.

sentences.zh: 為總督數以敗聞，由是漸失寵。

translations.literal: As grand coordinator he was repeatedly reported defeated and gradually lost favor.
translations.idiomatic: As grand coordinator he was repeatedly defeated and gradually lost favor.

sentences.zh: 既有言不練主兵者，益大恚，謂：「忬怠事，負我。」

translations.literal: When there was talk of not drilling allotted troops he grew all the angrier, saying: "Yu is slack and has failed me.
translations.idiomatic: When told allotted troops were not drilled he grew angrier, saying Yu had failed him.

sentences.zh: 嵩雅不悅忬。

translations.literal: Song had long disliked Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Song had long disliked Yu.

sentences.zh: 而忬子世貞復用口語積失歡於嵩子世蕃。

translations.literal: Yu's son Shizhen also accumulated displeasure with Song's son Shifan through sharp words.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's son Shizhen also angered Shifan through sharp words.

sentences.zh: 嚴氏客又數以世貞家瑣事構於嵩父子。

translations.literal: Clients of the Yan clan repeatedly framed the Wang household in petty matters before father and son.
translations.idiomatic: Yan clients repeatedly framed the Wang household before father and son.

sentences.zh: 楊繼盛之死，世貞又經紀其喪，嵩父子大恨。

translations.literal: At Yang Jisheng's death Shizhen arranged the funeral; the Yan father and son hated this deeply.
translations.idiomatic: At Yang Jisheng's death Shizhen arranged the funeral; the Yans hated this deeply.

sentences.zh: 灤河變聞，遂得行其計。

translations.literal: When news of the Luan River disaster arrived, they were able to carry out their plan.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the Luan River disaster arrived, they carried out their plan.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，世貞與弟世懋伏闕訟冤。

translations.literal: When the Muzong Emperor ascended the throne, Shizhen and his younger brother Shimao knelt at the palace gate pleading injustice.
translations.idiomatic: When the Longqing Emperor ascended the throne, Shizhen and his brother Shimao knelt at the palace gate pleading injustice.

sentences.zh: 復故官，予恤。

translations.literal: His former office was restored and consolation granted.
translations.idiomatic: His former office was restored and consolation granted.

sentences.zh: 楊選，字以公，章丘人。

translations.literal: Yang Xuan, style name Yigong, was a native of Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xuan, whose style was Yigong, came from Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the twenty-third year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 授行人。

translations.literal: He was appointed courier.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed courier.

sentences.zh: 擢御史，遷易州兵備副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor and transferred to vice commissioner for military preparedness at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor, then vice commissioner for military preparedness at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 俺答圍大同右衛，巡撫朱笈被逮，超拜選右僉都御史代之。

translations.literal: When Altan besieged Datong Right Guard and Grand Coordinator Zhu Ji was arrested, Xuan was abruptly promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan besieged Datong Right Guard and Zhu Ji was arrested, Xuan was abruptly promoted to replace him.

sentences.zh: 與侍郎江東、總兵官張承勛解其圍。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Minister Jiang Dong and Regional Commander Zhang Chengxun he relieved the siege.
translations.idiomatic: With Vice Minister Jiang Dong and Regional Commander Zhang Chengxun he relieved the siege.

sentences.zh: 憂歸，再起，仍故職。

translations.literal: He returned home in mourning, was recalled, and resumed his former post.
translations.idiomatic: He returned for mourning, was recalled, and resumed his former post.

sentences.zh: 四十年擢總督薊遼副都御史。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief as grand coordinator of Ji and Liao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief, Grand Coordinator of Ji and Liao.

sentences.zh: 條上封疆極弊十五事，多從其請。

translations.literal: He submitted fifteen items on extreme abuses of the frontier; most requests were granted.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted fifteen items on frontier abuses; most were granted.

sentences.zh: 以居庸岔道卻敵功，進兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: For repelling the enemy at the Juyong side road he was promoted to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: For repelling the enemy at the Juyong side road he was promoted to Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，古北口守將遣哨卒山塞，朵顏衛掠其四人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, Juyong defenders sent scouts beyond the pass; Tumed Guard seized four of them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year, scouts beyond Juyong were seized by Tumed Guard.

sentences.zh: 部長通漢叩關索賞，副總兵胡鎮執之，並縛其黨十余人。

translations.literal: Chief Tonghan knocked at the pass seeking reward; Vice Commander Hu Zhen arrested him and bound more than ten of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Tonghan sought reward at the pass; Hu Zhen arrested him and bound more than ten followers.

sentences.zh: 通漢子懼，擁所執哨卒至墻下，請易其父。

translations.literal: Tonghan's son, afraid, brought the seized scouts to the wall and asked to exchange for his father.
translations.idiomatic: Tonghan's son brought seized scouts to the wall to exchange for his father.

sentences.zh: 通漢者，辛愛妻義父也，選欲以牽制辛愛，要其子入質，乃遣還父。

translations.literal: Tonghan was Xin'ai's wife's adoptive father; Xuan wished to constrain Xin'ai and demanded the son as hostage before returning the father.
translations.idiomatic: Tonghan was Xin'ai's wife's adoptive father; Xuan demanded the son as hostage before returning the father.

sentences.zh: 自是諸子叠為質，半歲而代。

translations.literal: Thereafter sons were hostages in succession, replaced every half year.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter sons served as hostages in rotation every half year.

sentences.zh: 選馳疏以聞，自詡方略。

translations.literal: Xuan hurriedly memorialized reporting this and praised his own strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan hurriedly memorialized and praised his own strategy.

sentences.zh: 選及巡撫徐紳等俱受賞。

translations.literal: Xuan and Grand Coordinator Xu Shen and others all received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan, Xu Shen, and others all received rewards.

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯，辛愛與把都兒等大舉自墻子嶺、磨刀峪潰墻入犯，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the tenth month Xin'ai with Badu'er and others raided in force through Qiangziling and Modaoyu, breaking the wall; the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the tenth month Xin'ai and Badu'er broke through Qiangziling and Modaoyu; the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 帝大驚，諭閣臣徐階曰：「朕東見火光，此賊去京不遠，其令兵部諭諸軍並力剿逐。」

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly alarmed and told Grand Secretary Xu Jie: "I see firelight to the east—the bandits are not far from the capital; order the Ministry of War to tell all armies to pursue together.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Xu Jie: "I see firelight east—the raiders are near; order all armies to pursue together.

sentences.zh: 明日，選以寇東遁聞，為將士祈賞。

translations.literal: The next day Xuan reported the bandits had fled east and requested rewards for officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Xuan reported raiders fled east and requested rewards.

sentences.zh: 帝疑，以問階。

translations.literal: The emperor was suspicious and asked Jie.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was suspicious and asked Jie.

sentences.zh: 對曰：「寇營尚在平谷，選等往通州矣，謂追殺者，妄也。」

translations.literal: Jie replied: "The bandit camp is still at Pinggu; Xuan and others have gone to Tongzhou—the claim of pursuit is false.
translations.idiomatic: Jie replied: "The camp is still at Pinggu; Xuan is at Tongzhou—the pursuit claim is false.

sentences.zh: 帝銜之。

translations.literal: The emperor bore a grudge.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 寇稍東，大掠三河、順義，圍諸將傅津等於鄭官屯。

translations.literal: The bandits moved somewhat east, plundered greatly in Sanhe and Shunyi, and besieged Generals Fu Jin and others at Zhengguan Village.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders moved east, plundered Sanhe and Shunyi, and besieged Fu Jin at Zhengguan Village.

sentences.zh: 選遣副將胡鎮偕總兵官孫臏、遊擊趙溱擊之。

translations.literal: Xuan dispatched Vice Commander Hu Zhen with Regional Commander Sun Bin and Raiding Commander Zhao Qin to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan dispatched Hu Zhen with Sun Bin and Zhao Qin to attack.

sentences.zh: 臏、溱戰歿，鎮力戰得脫。

translations.literal: Bin and Qin died in battle; Zhen fought hard and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Bin and Qin died in battle; Zhen escaped.

sentences.zh: 寇留內地八日不退。

translations.literal: The bandits remained inland eight days without withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders remained inland eight days without withdrawing.

sentences.zh: 紿事中李瑜遂劾選、紳與副使盧鎰，參將馮詔、胡粲，遊擊嚴瞻等，俱逮下詔獄。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Li Yu impeached Xuan, Shen, Vice Commissioner Lu Yi, Battalion Commander Feng Zhao, Hu Can, and Raiding Commander Yan Zhan; all were arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu impeached Xuan, Shen, Lu Yi, Feng Zhao, Hu Can, and Yan Zhan; all were arrested.

sentences.zh: 又二日，寇始北去，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: Two days later the bandits at last withdrew north and the capital alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later raiders withdrew north and the alert was lifted.

sentences.zh: 初，諜者言寇將窺墻子嶺，部檄嚴待之，而三衛為寇導者紿選赴潘家口。

translations.literal: Earlier spies said the bandits would watch Qiangziling; the ministry ordered strict defense, but the three guards who guided the bandits deceived Xuan into going to Panjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Spies warned of Qiangziling, but three guards guiding raiders deceived Xuan toward Panjiakou.

sentences.zh: 寇已入，選、紳懼得罪，徑趨都城，屯東直門外，旋還通州。

translations.literal: After the bandits entered, Xuan and Shen, fearing guilt, hurried to the capital, encamped outside Dongzhimen, then returned to Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After raiders entered, Xuan and Shen hurried to the capital, encamped at Dongzhimen, then Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 及遣鎮等禦，又不勝。

translations.literal: When Zhen and others were sent to resist, they again could not win.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhen was sent to resist, he again could not win.

sentences.zh: 內侍家薊西者，嘩言通漢父子實召寇。

translations.literal: Eunuchs whose homes were west of Ji clamored that Tonghan father and son had actually summoned the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs from west of Ji claimed Tonghan father and son summoned the raiders.

sentences.zh: 帝入其言，益怒。

translations.literal: The emperor believed this and grew angrier.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor believed this and grew angrier.

sentences.zh: 法司坐選、紳、詔守備不設律斬，鎰等戍。

translations.literal: The judicial offices sentenced Xuan, Shen, and Zhao to execution for failing to prepare defenses; Yi and others to banishment.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial offices sentenced Xuan, Shen, and Zhao to death; Yi and others to banishment.

sentences.zh: 帝諭錦衣朱希孝坐以縱通漢勾賊罪，復下選詔獄。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Embroidered Uniform Guard Zhu Xixiao to convict on the charge of indulging Tonghan to entice bandits and sent Xuan again to prison.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Zhu Xixiao to convict for indulging Tonghan and sent Xuan to prison again.

sentences.zh: 選不承，止承質通漢父子事，且言事已上聞。

translations.literal: Xuan did not confess except to holding Tonghan father and son hostage, saying the matter had been reported.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan confessed only to holding Tonghan hostage, saying it had been reported.

sentences.zh: 希孝錄其語上，刑部如帝指論選死。

translations.literal: Xixiao recorded his words and reported up; the Ministry of Punishments sentenced death as the emperor directed.
translations.idiomatic: Xixiao recorded his words; the ministry sentenced death as directed.

sentences.zh: 即戳於市，梟其首示邊，妻子流二千里。

translations.literal: He was immediately executed in the market, his head displayed on the frontier, wife and children exiled two thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: He was executed, his head displayed on the frontier, wife and children exiled two thousand li.

sentences.zh: 紳論死系獄，詔及鎰等戍邊。

translations.literal: Shen was sentenced to death and imprisoned; Zhao and Yi and others banished to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Shen was sentenced to death and imprisoned; Zhao and Yi were banished.

sentences.zh: 帝雖怒選甚，但欲誅其身，法司乃並坐其妻子。

translations.literal: Though the emperor hated Xuan greatly, he wished only to kill him personally; the judicial offices implicated wife and children as well.
translations.idiomatic: Though the emperor wished only to kill Xuan, the judicial offices implicated wife and children.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，始釋還。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing they were at last released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Longqing they were released.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：世宗威柄自操，用重典以繩臣下，而弄權者借以行其私。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Emperor Shizong wielded authority himself, using severe statutes to bind his subjects, while those who manipulated power used them to pursue private ends.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Emperor Shizong wielded authority himself, using severe law to bind officials, while power-players pursued private ends.

sentences.zh: 於是賜阘冗廢職之徒事敗伏辜，而出力任事之臣亦中危法受戮，邊臣不得自展布，而武備綍矣。

translations.literal: Thus worthless men who failed in office suffered punishment, while meritorious servants also fell under dangerous law and were executed; frontier officials could not act freely and military preparedness declined.
translations.idiomatic: Thus worthless failures were punished while meritorious servants were executed; frontier officials could not act and military preparedness declined.

sentences.zh: 陳九疇、翟鵬、孫繼魯、曾銑皆可用之才，或謫或死，不以其罪。

translations.literal: Chen Jiuchou, Di Peng, Sun Jilu, and Ceng Xian were all usable talents, yet were demoted or died without deserving their fates.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jiuchou, Di Peng, Sun Jilu, and Ceng Xian were usable talents, yet were demoted or died undeservedly.

sentences.zh: 銑復套之議甚偉。

translations.literal: Xian's proposal to recover the Ordos was very grand.
translations.idiomatic: Xian's proposal to recover the Ordos was grand.

sentences.zh: 然權臣當軸，而敵勢方強，雖頗、牧烏能有為？

translations.literal: Yet with powerful ministers holding power and the enemy strong, even Pian and Mu could accomplish anything?
translations.idiomatic: Yet with powerful ministers in power and the enemy strong, could even Pian and Mu accomplish anything?

sentences.zh: 丁汝夔之戮，於法誠不為過。

translations.literal: Ding Rukui's execution was not unjust by law.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Rukui's execution was not unjust by law.

sentences.zh: 然戎律之弛，有由來矣，而汝夔獨蒙其咎。

translations.literal: Yet the slackening of military law had long been coming, and Rukui alone bore the blame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet military law had long been slackening, and Rukui alone bore the blame.

sentences.zh: 王忬、楊選於邊備甚疏，宜不免雲。

translations.literal: Wang Yu and Yang Xuan were very lax in frontier defense and could hardly escape blame.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu and Yang Xuan were lax in frontier defense and could hardly escape blame.
